title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 134 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 134 - Collection of Tax on Transfer of Shares The person responsible for registering the transfer of shares in a company which is not registered from a resident person to another person shall not register such transfer, unless the resident transferee deposit challan of tax payment at the rate of 15% (fifteen percent) on the difference between the face value and the fair value of the shares transferred. Explanation- For the purposes of this section- (a) “Face Value” means the price determined by the issuer and includes any additional amount if the same; (i) completed by bank transfer; and (ii) is properly shown in the income tax return of the taxpayer; (b) “Fair Value” means the fair value determined by the Professional valuer in the valuation report made before the transfer of shares; Click here to see English version বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য: এই ওয়েবসাইটে উল্লিখিত কোনো কিছু যদি সরকার কর্তৃক ইস্যুকৃত আইন, বিধি, প্রজ্ঞাপন ও আদেশের সহিত সাংঘর্ষিক হয় সেইক্ষেত্রে উক্ত ইস্যুকৃত আইন, বিধি, প্রজ্ঞাপন ও আদেশই প্রাধান্য পাবে।
